title: Meltano Job Run Duration p95
app: Meltano ELT run logs via UF and the Meltano Cloud API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=meltano:run exit_code=0
| eval dur_s=round(duration_s/1,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by job_name
| where p95_s>600
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile run duration for each job in Meltano and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Meltano jobs by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Meltano timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest jobs with their owners.
visualization: Table of job by p95 run duration, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Meltano so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
